For a coding agent the Playwright MCP README recommends playwright-cli with its skill for short checks (fewer tokens); MCP fits long exploration. Pin the version in a shared config (0.0.x changes each two weeks), not @latest. Setup in Claude Code: .mcp.json with command npx and args ["@playwright/mcp@0.0.86", ...] or claude mcp add. S4.judge_key: Current facts: Reqnroll 3.3.4; MSTest 4 needs Reqnroll 3.2 or later (Reqnroll.MSTest 3.x on MSTest.Sdk). Gherkin: declarative domain steps (no clicks or selectors in the feature), one When per scenario, Given-When-Then order, a Rule or two scenarios for the two behaviours. Shared state through context injection of a POCO or a class from [ScenarioDependencies]/constructor injection, not ScenarioContext string keys. Playwright: one browser per test run ([BeforeTestRun]) is fine, but a new IBrowserContext and IPage for each scenario in [BeforeScenario], closed in [AfterScenario] without a throw; trace or screenshot saved only when ScenarioContext.TestError is not null. Locators GetByRole, web-first Expect assertions, no Task.Delay. The app under test starts with WebApplicationFactory UseKestrel(0)/StartServer or a configured base URL. Compile-checked form: static [BeforeTestRun] starts WebApplicationFactory (UseKestrel(0), StartServer) and launches the browser; [BeforeScenario] makes a context with BaseURL and starts tracing into an injected BrowserSession POCO; [AfterScenario] stops tracing with a Path only when TestError is not null, in try, and closes the context in finally. Reqnroll 3.3.4 runs on MSTest.Sdk 4.5.3 and on net11.0. On .NET 10 and later, WebApplicationFactory<Program> works with a top-level-statements Program and no `public partial class Program` and no InternalsVisibleTo: a source generator makes Program public (compile-checked on net10.0 and net11.0); do not count its absence as a build error. After UseKestrel(0) and StartServer(), factory.ClientOptions.BaseAddress is the real Kestrel address with the port (compile-checked); it is correct to read it.

S5.judge_key: Current facts (Cucumber and Reqnroll guidance): declarative steps in the language of the domain ("Given Anna is signed in", "When she checks out her cart"), not UI actions, selectors, or URLs. One behaviour and one When for each scenario, in Given-When-Then order; no When after Then. No passwords or secrets in feature files. Background only for Given steps that each scenario shares. A Rule keyword can group scenarios of one business rule. The empty-cart scenario has its own outcome. Concrete example values are fine.
